extracted.name: Bourbon Cream Cheese Frosting
extracted.description: A delicious twist on cream cheese frosting. This is great for decorating red velvet cake and would be excellent on banana cake.
instruction_lines: Combine butter and cream cheese in a large bowl; beat with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy.
Add confectioners’ sugar and bourbon. Beat until frosting is smooth and spreadable.
